attempts.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance on node1, and validated persistence across a real node restart. Config written to /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route = 0 for all/default), applied at runtime including to the live enp1s0 interface. node1 was then rebooted via systemctl reboot; boot_id changed from bccb87ac-2704-41fb-ab29-fb36e0053c13 to 242efcb7-4043-48e9-bc22-e109c236060c, proving an actual restart. Post-reboot verification confirmed all/default and enp1s0 sysctls remained 0. Loopback's accept_redirects reset to 1 due to kernel init ordering (lo is created before sysctl.d applies) — not security-relevant since redirects don't apply meaningfully to lo — and was re-set to 0 for completeness.
